parts.watchFor: Ismail grows up in the valley. Watch what he's known for.

questions.q: What message did Ibrahim leave for Ismail with the wife who complained?
options: Change the threshold of your door

questions.q: Who did God raise ages later from Ismail's line?
options: The messenger Ibrahim had prayed for

lesson.text: Ismail kept his word and taught his family prayer. Gratitude at home matters: the wife who thanked God for what they had was the one Ibrahim told him to keep.
lesson.curious: Muslims honour Ismail, Ishmael in the Bible, as a prophet who kept his promises. Muslims trace the Prophet Muhammad's line back to him.

carry.title: Ibrahim's prayer for a messenger from his line

reflect.muslim: Is there a promise you've let slide? What would it take to keep it this week?
reflect.curious: How much does keeping your word matter to the people around you?

parts.act: Keep every promise you make this week, however small.

parts.watchFor: Ibrahim, old now, is given a second son. Watch how one family carries one message.

questions.q: Who bore Ishaq, as the angels had promised?
What message did both of Ibrahim's lines carry?
options: That they should rule the land
That God alone is to be worshipped

lesson.text: From Ibrahim came two lines, Ismail's and Ishaq's, and both carried one message: worship God alone. And God gives in His own time: Sarah bore Ishaq when she was old.
lesson.curious: Ibrahim's two sons, Ismail and Ishaq (Isaac), are honoured as prophets in Islam. Muslims see Jews, Christians and Muslims as sharing Ibrahim as a father in faith.

reflect.muslim: What do you hope your family will carry on from you?
reflect.curious: What has your family passed down to you that you'd want to keep?

parts.act: Ask an older relative about your family's story, and what they hope you'll carry on.
